description: 3 positives (1 de) + 2 near-misses + 1 counterexample. This skill is explicit-request-only, so the positives all name the pipeline or its product: turning a learning from the session just finished into a durable artefact. The near-misses are the two surfaces that also write artefacts but do not run the capture-classify-create-validate-apply loop — authoring one named skill from scratch, and writing a memory entry. The counterexample guards the word 'improve' used about code.
